post.text: Punch wakes up slowly… and the first thing he looks for isn’t the world — it’s his orange mama, the one that stayed when no one else did. https://t.co/32clGJXisY
post.author_description: Paws & aura: unmatched. Living my 9 lives 99 vibes in 4K 🐁🐇🐘🐦🐼

description.description: A baby monkey is cuddling a large, fluffy stuffed orangutan on stony ground. In the first frame, the monkey has its eyes closed and is nestled against the toy's chest. In the second frame, the monkey opens its eyes and looks to the side. In the third frame, it adjusts its position, holding onto the toy's arm.

tweetMedia.transcription: Puss, puss, puss. Puss, puss, puss.
